shorts.title: Bring Hearts to the Christmas table
shorts.hookBottom:
Four around the table?
Make it a Hearts night.
shorts.tagline:
Learn it now.
Play this Christmas.
shorts.outroBottom:
One deck. Four players.
A Christmas card table.
shorts.caption: Bring a deck to the Christmas table. In this Hearts hand, Q♠, K♠ and A♠ are your only spades. Which three would you pass? Learn the decisions with Barbu, then put the phone down and play together. Barbu is single-player practice, not online multiplayer. Find Barbu: Learn Card Games on Google Play through our channel profile. #Hearts #CardGames #Christmas
shorts.conversationPrompt: Who taught you Hearts? What is the one rule you would explain before dealing at Christmas?

shorts.title: Just two of you this Christmas? Try Gin Rummy
shorts.hookBottom:
Gin Rummy is made for two.
Try one decision before you deal.
shorts.tagline:
Learn a new game.
Play this Christmas.
shorts.outroBottom:
Two players. One deck.
Make time for a card game.
shorts.caption: Just two of you at the Christmas card table? Try Gin Rummy. Keep your sets and runs, then choose a discard: in this hand, K♠ leaves just two deadwood points. Practise with Barbu before playing together with a real deck. Barbu is single-player practice, not online multiplayer. Google Play link on our channel profile. #GinRummy #CardGames #Christmas
shorts.conversationPrompt: What is your favourite two-player card game? Would this help you teach Gin Rummy to someone over Christmas?
